title: track 1.3
description: tracks::Track (experimental): a tracks.Track row, its files and its rows in every data set. Stock rows are game/<code> with time_trial true. An added track clones base's rows in every data set that holds base; slot fills a dormant stock row (one without assets) instead of adding a row. provides lists the venue/ ids it provides.

code.description: The track code: its folder under environment_package/tracks/ and its tracks.Track row label.

base.description: The track whose rows it clones in every data set; null on a stock row.

slot.description: A dormant stock row it fills (game/sochi); null: a new row.

provides.description: The venue/ ids it provides: a reference to the venue resolves to the last enabled provider in load order.

time_trial.description: Offered in Time Trial boxes; stock tracks true, added tracks false.

sprint.description: The TrackDataSet labels ("f1", "f1_2026") in which an added track's weekend is a sprint weekend. Every other data set gets weekend_format default, whatever the base has.

video.description: The track's circuit intro, the pre-race map: a Bink 2 file (.bk2, 1920x1080, no audio) in the addon's folder, such as "videos/okayama.bk2", that every box plays. Or an object with a file per box, f1 for the boxes before 2026 and f1_2026 for the F1 2026 box (at least one); the F1 2026 box without its key plays f1, the others without f1 play f1_2026, since the track has one row. The build places the files under videos/track_map/swofty/ and the core points the track's TrackVideo row at them. Without it, the track plays its base's intro. There is no key for F2 intros.

extends.description: Data files only: this record is a variant of that record, and its value is a merge patch on the base.

time_trial_video.description: The background video of the Time Trial track select for this track: a Bink 2 file in the addon's folder, such as "videos/okayama-select.bk2", that every box shows. Or an object with a file per box, f1 for the boxes before 2026 and f1_2026 for the F1 2026 box (at least one); the F1 2026 box without its key shows f1, the others without f1 have none. The build places it at videos/track_select/<code>.bk2 and videos/track_select/26/<code>.bk2, the names the game gives the track by its code. It shows only where the track offers Time Trial.

names.description: tracks::TrackNames: the names menus read from TrackNameData.

text.description: A Text: a lang key as a string, or a literal.

path.description: A Path: a file or folder in the addon's folder, the game's original file (stock), or resources in an archive. null: empty.

stat_id.description: A StatId: an explicit tracks.Track statId (0 to 254; 255 is the game's "no track"), or "auto" (absent: "auto") for the core to allocate one.
